name: Yoshioka Shiori
source:
Born in Tokyo. The oldest of three sisters. Blood-Hard-working with a serious personality. She’s the wholehearted type who does her best when it comes to the nitty-gritty. She’s fond of AYA and YUKARI’s talents.

[From [url=http://gematsu.com/2016/02/root-letter-dev-diary-discusses-key-elements]Gematsu[/url]]
